title: Simultaneously match two cubic targets and retain coupled quartic phases
statement: For an actual compatible G_delta with phase-independent covariance S, cubic moment ell1(C)*cos(delta1)+ell2(C)*cos(delta2), and quartic moment f0+fc*cos(delta1)*cos(delta2)+fs*sin(delta1)*sin(delta2), take positive weights w_i and actual rank-one R_i reproducing S. Background matrices X_i,Y_i must match ell1,ell2 for every admitted cubic. With A_i=cos(delta1)*X_i+cos(delta2)*Y_i and literal Hessian cost matrix K, require Pcos=[[t1,fc/2],[fc/2,t2]]-K positive semidefinite and Psin=[[t1,fs/2],[fs/2,t2]] positive semidefinite. Then f-E=(f0-t1-t2)+cosvec^T*Pcos*cosvec+sinvec^T*Psin*sinvec. A positive residual budget and the positive Hessian identity give the scoped variational bound. Feasibility is demonstrated for the retained pattern, not asserted for all fields or leading quartics.
